overview: A television series based on the novel of the same name by B. Izyumsky. It follows the fates of the students of the Suvorov Military School who honorably took up the baton from their commanders during the Great Patriotic War, and explores the present-day Soviet Army, shaping character, and cultivating courage in young soldiers.
title: Алые погоны

overview: "Battle for the Sky: The History of Russian Military Aviation" is a comprehensive 8-part documentary series produced by the Zvezda TV channel. The project covers more than a century of the evolution of the Russian air force—from the first wooden "shelves" of the early 20th century to today's fifth-generation supersonic fighters.
title: Битва за небо. История военной авиации России
Без права на ошибку. История и вооружение инженерных войск

overview: Our time. On her sixtieth birthday, Maria Grigorieva receives an envelope from a stranger. Inside, she finds a ring and an open letter signed with the pseudonym "Sweet Hedgehog." Maria recalls that this was what she used to call her numerous lovers. She mentally travels back in time to figure out who could have sent such a touching letter.
title: Желанная

overview: Each of us wants to know where happiness awaits. We'll look into the future and reveal all the secrets of the zodiac signs, including the power of the 13th sign.
title: 13 знаков зодиака

overview: The first humorous travel show. Comedians Max Perlov and Timur Rodriguez travel around the world, experiencing the most unusual experiences.
title: Бешенл Джеографик

overview: Emma and Leo get married, but will their love endure as they struggle against conformity?
title: Ils vécurent heureux

overview: Documentary which goes behind the scenes at Tatler, the world's oldest magazine. The publication has been reporting on the lives of Britain's most privileged and powerful for 300 years.
title: Posh People: Inside Tatler

overview: This series explores some of the most startling criminal cases of the past two decades where technology has changed the course of the investigations.
title: Evidence of Evil

overview: James May returns with a brand-new series, taking on the everyday frustrations that unite a nation in grumbles. From his Wiltshire home, his pub, and most importantly his shed, James sets out to dream up imaginative fixes for the problems blighting Britain and stirring up public annoyance. Armed with his trademark wit and curiosity – and joined once again by his engineer sidekick Sim and series favourite Tony "The Tool" – James dives into a fresh set of challenges. Whether it's tackling practical irritations or exploring the country's bigger gripes, this inventive trio use humour, creativity, and a shed-load of tools to prove that no problem is too small (or too ridiculous) to try and solve.
title: James May's Shed Load of Ideas

overview: Four cheerful and close friends constantly get involved in different adventures. Each of them turned fifty, but they fill their lives with a bright, interesting meaning. Every day one of them gets into some kind of frivolous story. This is a series about love relationships, about the fate of four bosom friends and their true male friendship.
title: Бес в ребро, или Великолепная четверка

overview: Alexander Litvinov belongs to the generation of Russian clerks. Glossy magazines impose on him a lifestyle he cannot afford; his environment demands success and professional ambition from him. Alexander's real estate career is not going particularly well; his last chance to turn things around is to get hold of a plot of land that once belonged to a pioneer camp. However, the land is occupied. Strange research is being conducted there. The aliens want to find out how humane humanity is and whether it's time to shut down the test site called Earth. To save civilization, Alexander must learn to live by different values.
title: Невозможные зеленые глаза

overview: About the lives of the crew members of the submarine "Varshavyanka". The crew members of B‑556 serve with dignity. The closed world of the submarine imposes its own conditions: there is no distinction between day and night here; you need to be on guard both day and night. But the sea prepares many unforeseen circumstances for the heroes. They will have to participate in rescuing a Russian tanker, help drowning fishermen, and assist oceanologists. Before that, the submariners will take on board the mysterious female pilot Galina, who was involved in a plane crash and ended up on the open sea. Her appearance on the submarine will stir up trouble in the hearts of some of the characters, and events will begin to unfold in an unexpected way.
title: Автономка

overview: Already from the title of the film it is obvious that we are talking about residents of a big city, charming young ladies of "Balzac age" - "a little over thirty". This age formula of "maturity and flowering" was brought out by the great French theorist (and, of course, practitioner) of love Honore de Balzac in his novel "The Thirty-Year-Old Woman". The second part of the name is a direct consequence of the first. What else to do for beautiful and unmarried girls, if not the search for love? Well, where is the search - there are mistakes, and disappointments, and those same "muzhiks" who sometimes behave like uniform "own ...". The combination of irony and sincerity, comedy and melodrama, recognizable situations of the difficult amorous life of a modern metropolis give this love-comedy cocktail an original, piquant taste. Vera, Alla, Sonya and Yulia are old friends.
title: Бальзаковский возраст, или Все мужики сво...

overview: Our flagship 30-minute program features the very best of Pastor Doug Batchelor and Amazing Facts programs. Explore the Bible like never before and get practical guidance on Christian living, prophecy, and more. You will find the Bible's answers to all your questions about life on Amazing Facts with Doug Batchelor.
title: Amazing Facts with Doug Batchelor
The Haoge of Erlonghu: No Rogues Under Heaven

overview: Sunny and warm-hearted high schooler Xia Fanxing is known as the campus "hidden gem"—someone whose presence can soothe any wounded soul. Sheng Yang, a transfer student and former champion of the National Youth Table Tennis Championships, was forced to give up the sport for reasons he can't talk about. His world stays dim—until he meets her. Determined to help Sheng Yang step out of his shadows, Xia Fanxing tries every method imaginable, from gentle persuasion to hilarious tough love, leading to a series of funny and heartfelt mishaps. But as they grow closer, Sheng Yang gradually realizes that behind Xia Fanxing's bright smile and endless emotional support lies a pain she carefully hides from others. She wraps her wounds in sunshine, an introvert pretending to be an extrovert. After learning the truth, Sheng Yang makes a quiet promise: she can continue being the sun for everyone else—and he will be the sun for her. From that moment on, a tender, healing, and sweet love story unfolds.
title: Hearts in Play

overview: Get a stunning view of the soul, strength and spirit of this historic land on Aerial Mexico
title: Aerial Mexico

overview: Adapted from a novel by Feng Huo Xi Zhu Hou, the story follows a small town that looks ordinary but is secretly on the verge of collapse. As powerful forces scheme using the town as their battleground, a humble young man, Chen Ping'an, dares to challenge fate with courage and determination. Armed with only a sword, he fights to survive and protect his path forward.
title: The One
Feng He Jin Qi Zhang Ju Zheng

overview: Repeated attempts to locate Siberian diamonds proved fruitless. The latest expedition began with a dramatic event: the sudden death of its leader. But the geologists decided to continue their journey. Thus began a difficult, perilous trek for a handful of people along the taiga's "diamond trail."
title: Алмазная тропа

overview: Olga Zhuravleva is a successful dentist and the owner of her own small clinic located in a country hotel. But Olya is unlucky in love... She has been dating a married man for four years. One morning, she learns that he has finally divorced. However, her joy is short-lived, as he divorced not for her, a stern, serious brunette, but for a young and frivolous blonde.
title: Блондинка и брюнетка

overview: Vladimir Suvorov, a retired military man who spent 25 years in the Air Force, comes to visit Tamara, a saleswoman in the small village of Olkhovka. They met in the south, struck up a brief holiday romance, and Tamara couldn't imagine their story could continue. She invites Vladimir to live together for a while, get to know each other, and then decide what to do next. Writer Kruglikov lives next door to Tamara. With his royalties, he could have lived in Europe, but he chose Olkhovka. According to him, this is the real Russia, which the city's intellectuals don't know and fear. At first glance, the village is a perfect idyll—everyone has a job, the best doctors in the region, and virtually no crime—live and be happy. But whether Suvorov will settle here is not up to him or Tamara to decide, but to the village's true master—Mayor Nikolai Bobr, who is accustomed to calling the shots and dictating the laws in his territory. Will Suvorov, who has spent his entire life following orders, be able to live by the rules by which all of Olkhovka lives?
title: Бобры

overview: The plot centers on four wronged women and four vibrant and complex destinies. Valentina, a former police major unjustly dismissed from the force; Zoya, a self-defense instructor who was raped in her youth; Zhenya, cruelly abandoned by her husband; and Tatyana, who served several years in prison for slander… What connects these two so dissimilar women, and is their meeting a coincidence? Is revenge their sole motivation, and why are they called "goddesses of justice"?
title: Богини правосудия

overview: In this weekly program, Turning Point with Dr. David Jeremiah also known as "David Jeremiah", delivers practical messages to the congregation at the Shadow Mountain Community Church in San Diego. Also featured is music from the Shadow Mountain Community Church Choir and Orchestra, as well as performances by musical guests that have included Steve Green and Charles Billingsley. Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, the show usually features special Christmas programming.
title: Turning Point with Dr. David Jeremiah

overview: Are you convinced that mountains are an impenetrable border? That ridges and sheer cliffs will stop any enemy? Such a belief can prove costly if relied upon in national defense. As past events have repeatedly proven, an experienced enemy can use the heights as a springboard for a surprise attack at any moment. This film explores the most heroic chapters in the history of Russian military mountaineering. It explores the complex art required to defeat the enemy even when the front recedes into the clouds. We'll explain when and why mountain rifle units were created, and why they are as indispensable today as they were centuries ago.
title: История отечественного военного альпинизма

overview: Alexey is madly in love with Anechka. She is the woman of his life. For her, he is willing to make any sacrifice, even take her blame and go to prison. Time passes, and Alexey discovers a talent for healing, learning from the herbalist Olga Afanasyevna. Believing himself to be responsible for the deaths of his loved ones, he readily gives up material possessions and embraces a reclusive lifestyle. Helping people becomes the meaning of his life.
title: Анечка

overview: The most amazing city on the planet! Emerging as if by magic, celebrated by poets, and surviving incredible trials. Petrograd. Leningrad. Petersburg. Its strength and magic remain in its beauty. The beauty that was sheltered, saved, and preserved during the war and the siege. Evacuating valuables, camouflaging domes and spires, preserving architectural monuments, hiding sculptures. What efforts did it take? And how was Leningrad reborn from the ashes of the siege?
title: Непокоренная красота

overview: Come Dine With Me: Teens will, for the first time in CDWM history, see five teenagers try their hand at cooking up a menu and hosting their own dinner parties over five nights. The 16–19-year-old competitors will score each of their competing hosts with a mark out of 10 and the overall winner will scoop a £1,000 prize.
title: Come Dine With Me: Teens

overview: This Week is hosted by former Clinton White House staffer and current co-anchor of ABC's weekday morning news show "Good Morning America", George Stephanopoulos offers a look at current events with a focus on the politics of the day. Each week's show includes interviews with top newsmakers (including some of the nation's top political leaders) as well as a roundtable discussion, usually featuring journalists from ABC and other news organizations, of the week's happenings. Since 2008, the program has broadcast from a studio at the Newseum in Washington, D.C.
title: This Week

overview: Based on a comic serial written by Alan Moore and illustrated by David Lloyd. The story is set in Britain in a dystopian, not-too-distant future in which the country is controlled by the fascistic Norsefire party. An anarchist named V, known for his distinctive Guy Fawkes mask, seeks to topple the government with the help of Evey Hammond, a young woman V rescued from the country's secret police.
title: V for Vendetta

overview: The freelance queen Xin Tong, who never turns down a gig, takes on a task from her best friend: to sabotage a blind date. Unexpectedly, her target is Wen Pei'an, heir to the Sihai Group. Facing intense pressure from his parents to marry, Wen Pei'an seizes the opportunity and hires Xin Tong to be his contract girlfriend. Together, they must outsmart the relationship inspector sent by his father, launching them into a hilarious journey of cohabitation and pretend romance.
title: Money Honey Brainy

overview: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships. A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyungdo now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.
title: Surely Tomorrow

overview: Entrepreneur Jiang Anlan enters a virtual game in search of his first love, Yao Yuan, launching a heartfelt pursuit that eventually brings them back together in the real world. As they prepare for their wedding, an old family feud resurfaces, putting their relationship to the test. Through misunderstandings, heartbreak, and even illness, the couple endures every trial and finally reconciling and achieving their destined happy ending.
title: Love is Always Online

overview: Petter Nyquist is taking his family out into the world! Now they will live with people who know war, poverty and climate change firsthand.
title: Petter og familien – dit ingen drar

overview: The Chase is on Aotearoa! Four Kiwi contestants must pit their wits against the Chaser, a ruthless quiz genius determined to stop them winning the cash prize. Hosted by Paul Henry,
title: The Chase New Zealand

overview: Face the Nation is a news interview program which airs every Sunday morning, live from the CBS studio in Washington D.C. It is dedicated to interviewing newsmakers on the latest issues. Guests include government leaders, politicians, and international figures in the news. CBS News… More correspondents engage the guests in a lively roundtable discussion focusing on current topics. The show started on November 7th, 1954, and was originally broadcast on both CBS Television and Radio Networks. After close to two decades, the program was taken off CBS radio.
title: Face the Nation

overview: After the death of her husband, the leader of Loetwara business ring, Erin is being prevented by his cousin from inheriting his assets. At the same time, she needs to not only fight to survive but also preserve everything that rightfully belongs to her son. Everything she is confronted with, work, money and even love, comes seeking something from her. Erin calls all of this the war of money".
title: Treasure War

overview: Xu Xiao Yang grew up under the high pressure of her mother. She had to accept everything arranged by her mother. She always felt that she was ordinary. Even when she was in school, she had a crush on the school idol Fu Yan Li, but she didn't dare to approach him and could only escape. Ten years later, she was 29 years old and worked as a small employee in a bank. The long-term work pressure caused her ill health. She went to the hospital for treatment but unexpectedly met Fu Yan Li as the attending physician. She didn't expect that he was also her blind date. After her mother issued the final task of getting married, Xu Xiao Tang decided, after drinking, that since she was going to be with someone she didn't like, she would indulge herself with the person she had secretly loved for ten years.
title: The Only Light

overview: This docuseries details how one street became the epicenter of Danish drug crime -- as told by those living in and around the community.
title: Kampen om Pusher Street

overview: My Nightmare Stalker tells the harrowing true story of how Emmy® Award-winning actress Eva LaRue and her daughter Kaya endured 12 years of terror at the hands of a relentless stalker. Operating from the shadows, he taunted and terrorized their lives while his identity remained a mystery, even to the FBI. In this gripping account, Eva reveals the constant fear, emotional toll, and the resolve, courage and resilience it took to protect her family.
title: My Nightmare Stalker: The Eva LaRue Story

overview: To take back her mother's company, Ye Qing Huan, the eldest daughter of the Ye family, planned to kill her father and keep her son. She chose Bo Yu Chuan in the club, but unexpectedly, Bo Yu Chuan was the richest man in Yancheng, with a net worth of hundreds of millions. He was in a car accident and lost his memory, and ended up getting together with Ye Qing Huan by accident. In fact, Bo Yu Chuan fell deeply in love with Ye Qing Huan many years ago. After regaining his memory, he hid his identity and helped Ye Qing Huan recover his mother's company.
title: Younger Husband Is Deeply In Love With Me

overview: The story of a man trapped in an emotional and physical tug-of-war. Though he's been with his loyal and loving partner for years, the memories of his ex - who ignited a passion like no other - continue to haunt him. As her struggles with lingering desires and the comfort of his current relationship, he must decide whether to embrace the love he has or chase the fire he lost. Will he learn to let go, or will temptation pull him back into the arms of his past?
title: Haunted Desires

overview: With Christmas around the corner, two blundering Sicilian friends working in Milan discover a dumpster that transports them to their families in seconds.
title: Sicilia Express

overview: Are we building disturbingly ugly buildings in the world's most beautiful country? Hans Olav Brenner travels around to find out what the state of Norwegian architecture is like.
title: Stygt?

overview: For almost as long as there has been television, there's been Meet the Press. The hourlong Sunday morning public affairs program has featured interviews with countless U.S. and world leaders, and has reviewed, analyzed and discussed the news of the week -- all while looking toward the week ahead.
title: Meet the Press

overview: In the violent underworld of New Zealand's outlaw bikers, a warrior torn between two lives, two callings and two families must decide which path defines his true destiny.
title: Nomad

overview: The Cult of the Real Housewife traces the dramatic rise of Faith Temple from its founding by the beloved Rosemary ‘Mama' Cosby, grandmother of Mary Crosby, to her passing, the controversial transfer of leadership, and her husband's marriage to Mary. This hotly contested bequeathment pushed Faith Temple into a controversial, new era. In addition to exploring the church and the allegations against it, the docuseries will elevate the voices of ex-congregants speaking out for the first time, including long-standing pillars of Faith Temple, the Enoch family, and provide deeply personal and disturbing accounts from family members such as Mary's sister, Denise Jefferson Odinaka, and Mary's cousin, Dan Cosby, along with his wife, Kim. The docuseries also features investigative journalists and bloggers who have been tracking this story from the beginning, as well as a leading cult expert who can offer insight around a playbook designed to enforce loyalty in mind-control cults.
title: The Cult of the Real Housewife

overview: "In the Kitchen" is a film project by Maxim Lagashkin and Maxim Peshkov, in which invited actors and hosts discuss the film industry on equal terms.
title: НА КУХНЕ

overview: Based on a web novel, this courtroom time-slip drama tells the story of an upright judge named Lee Han Yeong, who dies after being falsely accused, and ends up 20 years in the past.
title: The Judge Returns

overview: Daniel Major, a prodigious pianist, finds himself unable to play. To heal, he must uncover the latent trauma causing his blockage. His quest for the truth, fraught with danger and pitfalls, leads him to a most disturbing revelation, leaving Daniel to face an agonizing moral dilemma.
title: Dérive

overview: This documentary series explores the case of Fernando Báez Sosa, whose fatal beating by a group of young men was caught on video, shocking Argentina.
title: 50 segundos: El caso de Fernando Báez Sosa

overview: FOX NFL Kickoff provides a preview of the day's NFL action, including interviews with NFL newsmakers, reports from NFL game venues, breaking news and updates.
title: FOX NFL Kickoff

overview: Set in Gyeongseong in 1935, the series follows painter Yun Il Ho, who is tasked with creating a portrait of Song Jeong Hwa—a mysterious woman who has remained out of public view for more than half a century and is the subject of countless rumors. As he steps into her world, a web of secrets begins to unravel, pulling him deeper into a suspense-laced narrative.
title: Portraits of Delusion

overview: Ksenia Borodina presents the show "Second Chance"—a show where those who have already experienced a breakup but are ready to take another risk for the sake of love meet.
title: Второй шанс

overview: Posing as the ideal husband, Ye Dong weaves a web of deceit to usurp the Lin fortune. He orchestrates a scheme that leaves his wife, Lin Xia, blind and coldly disposes of her father. Emboldened by her blindness, he brazenly betrays her with his secretary right before her. However, when extreme abuse from Ye Dong's mother triggers a miraculous recovery of Lin Xia's sight, her world shatters and reforms. A phoenix rising from the ashes, she sets out on a path of vengeance to make her tormentor pay and cleanse her world of his corruption.
title: Vengeful Wife

overview: Two of India's sharpest women, Kajol and Twinkle, host a talk show that's fun, unhinged and sneakily insightful - featuring celebrity guests, wild takes, and total chaos. Like the fun table at the party - everyone's invited.
title: Two Much with Kajol and Twinkle

overview: In the chaos of the Republican era, two souls, once torn apart by a childhood kidnapping and misunderstanding, are reunited at an auction. Li Huang, now a powerful figure, purchases Lu Niansheng as her "gilded canary," only to find herself ensnared in his meticulously laid trap. A dangerous game of cat and mouse unfolds between captor and captive. From a crucible of torment and buried truths, they must unite to confront a greater enemy lurking in the shadows, forging their legend from a complex web of love and vengeance.
title: The Human Bait

overview: Expanding CBS Sports' NFL coverage on Sunday mornings is That Other Pregame Show hosted by Adam Schein, is a four-hour long companion show to CBS' "The NFL Today" presents a unique fan-focused take on all the week's NFL and college action, headlines, and hot-button issues, giving viewers the latest information as it happens. Analysts include former Oakland Raiders executive Amy Trask and CBS Sports Radio's Brandon Tierney, while ``The NFL Today'' cast -- Dan Marino, Boomer Esiason, Shannon Sharpe and Bill Cowher, as well as host James Brown and ``insider'' Jason La Canfora -- are regular contributors. The show also incorporates various forms of social media interaction, engaging the "TOPS" team with its viewers.
title: That Other Pregame Show

overview: Officers from the Homicide Department of the Warsaw Metropolitan Police confront violence, death, and the dark aspects of human nature every single day. Joining the seasoned detectives Banaś and Jóźwiak is a young, ambitious police officer - Tamara Rudnik. Right from the start, she is thrown into the heart of the brutal Warsaw underworld, where the lines between good and evil often blur dangerously. As each investigation raises more questions than answers, the officers must face not only ruthless criminals, but also their own inner demons.
title: Glina. Nowy rozdział

overview: The entire Earth is affected by climate change, occurring with a greater speed and scale than ever before. This program uses scientific data and the latest findings to raise awareness on its impact.
title: Impacts: Climates Change the World

overview: In each episode of Instant Décisif, we welcome a photographer whom we have asked to select three photos that have marked their life and their career.
title: Instant Décisif

overview: The series celebrates a reunion of sports superfans and comedy superstars Kevin Hart and Kenan Thompson for an all-new sports comedy talk show that will give fans a front-row seat to the ultimate crossover and transform the traditional world of sports commentary into must-watch TV. Powered by their signature unfiltered opinions and electrifying energy, Kevin and Kenan will offer hilarious takes on everything from the NFL and NBA to neighborhood pickup games and little league drama... because whether it's played in stadiums or backyards, all sports are Good Sports. Each episode will deliver a highlight reel of laughs, featuring exclusive interviews with the biggest stars in sports and entertainment, wickedly funny commentary on the week's top stories and highlights, and boldly original field pieces that will have viewers cheering from their couches. This is sports talk reimagined: louder, funnier and as unpredictable as overtime in Game 7.
title: Good Sports with Kevin Hart and Kenan Thompson

overview: For the first time ever, experts identify Hitler's DNA. What do his genes reveal about Hitler's heritage and origins, his neurology and drives?
title: Hitler's DNA: Blueprint of a Dictator

overview: From the icy desert of Svalbard to the sun-kissed Mediterranean, this six-part wildlife series explores Europe's most important and fascinating habitats and meets their most remarkable wild inhabitants. Blue whales, polar bears, and soaring golden eagles star alongside rarely seen marvels such as the rare Persian leopards. Packed with spectacular imagery and new-to-science behaviour, Europe is one of the most ambitious wildlife series ever made.
title: Europe's Wild Marvels

overview: There's always a story behind the winning numbers. This work of fiction based on true events follows five normal people who tried to cheat the lottery.
title: Me late que sí

overview: The NCAA FCS Football Championship Selection Special is a new annual College Football Selection show where postseason berths are awarded to the top football teams in the NCAA's FCS division.
title: NCAA FCS Football Championship Selection Special

overview: Meetings with people who have achieved success through persistence and courage. The participants share stories from their lives, discuss their paths toward their goals, and reflect on what "hustle" really means – that inner drive that won't let you give up.
title: Hustle Show

overview: The true story of the young bank clerk Jutta Graae, who is swept into the resistance movement when Germany occupies Denmark.
title: Kodenavn: Storfyrstinden
